닭고기.e: 닭 (chicken) + 고기 (meat). Fried chicken is just 치킨.
닭고기.t: Pronounced [닥꼬기]: in 닭, only ㄱ is pronounced before a consonant.

장 보다.forms: 장(을) 보다: 장을 봐요 · 장 봤어요 · 장 보러 가요
장 보다.m: to go grocery shopping, to do the shopping
장 보다.x: I do my grocery shopping at the supermarket every weekend.
장 보다.e: 장 means 'market' (as in 시장), so it's literally 'see the market'.
장 보다.t: Use 장 보다 for food and daily necessities; for clothes or fun shopping, say 쇼핑하다.

집주인.x: I sent this month's rent to the landlord.

택배.ex: 어제 주문한 물건이 오늘 택배로 왔어요.
택배.x: The thing I ordered yesterday came by delivery today.
택배.t: 택배 is for packages; food delivery is 배달, as in 배달 음식.

중년.ex: 중년이 되니까 건강에 더 신경을 쓰게 돼요.
중년.x: Now that I'm middle-aged, I pay more attention to my health.
중년.t: 중년 남성 and 중년 여성, 'middle-aged man/woman,' are common phrases in news and ads.

불안정.ex: 요즘 경제가 불안정해서 사람들이 돈을 잘 안 써요.
불안정.x: The economy is unstable these days, so people aren't spending much money.
불안정.t: 불- negates Sino words (불안정, 불평등, 불공평), but becomes 부- before ㄷ or ㅈ, as in 부족.

특파원.ex: 워싱턴 특파원이 현지 소식을 전해 드리겠습니다.
특파원.x: Our Washington correspondent will bring you the local news.

이론적.x: It's possible in theory, but difficult in reality.

증거.ex: 경찰은 아직 확실한 증거를 찾지 못했어요.
증거.x: The police still haven't found any solid evidence.

지지층.x: That candidate has a broad base of young supporters.
지지층.t: Collocations: 지지층이 두껍다 (a broad base) and 지지층을 결집하다 (rally supporters).

양도.ex: 이 티켓은 다른 사람에게 양도할 수 없습니다.
양도.x: This ticket cannot be transferred to anyone else.

독려하다.m: to urge on, to spur, to encourage
독려하다.ex: 감독은 선수들에게 끝까지 최선을 다하라고 독려했습니다.
독려하다.x: The coach urged the players to give their best to the end.
독려하다.e: Literally 'oversee and urge' — a leader pushing people forward.

중요시하다.m: to consider important, to value, to emphasize

점진적으로.x: The government plans to raise taxes gradually.

우후죽순.ex: 요즘 동네에 카페가 우후죽순처럼 생기고 있어요.
우후죽순.x: These days, cafés are popping up all over the neighborhood.

갈피를 잡다.forms: 갈피를 못 잡아요 · 갈피를 잡았어요 · 갈피를 잡을 수 없다
갈피를 잡다.m: to get one's bearings; to make sense of something (mostly in negatives)
갈피를 잡다.ex: 설명이 너무 복잡해서 갈피를 못 잡겠어요.
갈피를 잡다.x: The explanation is so complicated I can't make heads or tails of it.
갈피를 잡다.e: 갈피 = the space between pages, as in 책갈피 'bookmark.'
갈피를 잡다.t: Almost always negative: 갈피를 못 잡다 / 갈피를 잡을 수 없다.

법조인.ex: 그는 어릴 때부터 법조인이 되는 것이 꿈이었어요.
법조인.x: Ever since he was young, his dream was to become a legal professional.
법조인.e: Literally 'person of the law offices' — covers judges, prosecutors and lawyers together.

캐묻다.forms: 캐물어요 · 캐물었어요 · 캐물을 거예요 · 캐물으세요 (ㄷ irregular)
캐묻다.ex: 기자는 사고 원인에 대해 계속 캐물었어요.
캐묻다.x: The reporter kept pressing questions about the cause of the accident.
캐묻다.e: Built from 캐다 (to dig up) + 묻다 (to ask): 'dig while asking'.
캐묻다.t: Like 묻다 (ask), it is ㄷ irregular: 캐물어요, not 캐묻어요.

싼 게 비지떡.forms: 싼 게 비지떡이라더니 · 싼 게 비지떡이에요
싼 게 비지떡.m: you get what you pay for; cheap things are poor quality (lit. what's cheap is a cake of bean-curd dregs)
싼 게 비지떡.ex: 싼 게 비지떡이라더니, 인터넷에서 산 신발이 일주일 만에 찢어졌어요.
싼 게 비지떡.x: You get what you pay for: the shoes I bought online ripped after a week.
싼 게 비지떡.e: 비지 is the pulp left over from making tofu (두부); a 비지떡 made from it was cheap, coarse food.
싼 게 비지떡.t: Said when something cheap turns out badly. Its modern opposite is 가성비 'value for money', as in 가성비 좋은 'cheap but good'.

자유방임.x: Nineteenth-century Britain followed laissez-faire economic policies.
자유방임.e: Literally 'freedom and leaving things alone' — a translation of 'laissez-faire.'
자유방임.t: Also used for parenting: 자유방임형 부모 'a hands-off parent.'

극좌.ex: 그 단체는 극좌 성향이라는 비판을 받았습니다.
극좌.x: The group was criticized for having far-left leanings.

영해.ex: 외국 어선이 허가 없이 우리 영해에 들어왔습니다.
영해.x: A foreign fishing boat entered our territorial waters without permission.

세포막.ex: 세포막은 물질이 세포 안팎으로 드나드는 것을 조절합니다.
세포막.x: The cell membrane controls what goes in and out of the cell.

광년.ex: 그 별은 지구에서 약 사 광년 떨어져 있어요.
광년.x: That star is about four light-years from Earth.
광년.t: Like English, it measures distance, not time.

명문.m: well-written prose, fine piece of writing
명문.x: His speech is still regarded as a fine piece of writing.
명문.t: 명문 also means 'prestigious school or family' (名門), as in 명문대; context tells you which.

변주곡.x: Mozart wrote variations on 'Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Star.'
변주곡.e: -곡 = a musical piece: 변주곡, 협주곡, 교향곡.

창.m: singing (in pansori and traditional vocal music)
창.ex: 그는 어릴 때부터 스승에게 창을 배웠습니다.
창.x: He learned traditional singing from his teacher since childhood.
창.e: Homonym alert: 창 also means 'window' and 'spear'.
창.t: Pansori alternates 창 (singing) with 아니리 (spoken narration) and 발림 (gestures).

적이.x: I was quite relieved at the news that my family was safe.
적이.t: Literary; most common in 적이 안심하다. Don't confuse with 적이 'the enemy (subject)'.

획일화.m: standardization, uniformity, making everything the same
획일화.ex: 교육의 획일화는 학생들의 창의성을 떨어뜨릴 수 있습니다.
획일화.x: Uniformity in education can lower students' creativity.
획일화.e: Literally 'becoming drawn as one': forcing everything into a single mold.
획일화.t: Usually negative in tone, unlike 표준화, which is a neutral 'standardization'.

낙화유수.m: fallen flowers and flowing water; the fading of spring, passing time
낙화유수.x: Like fallen petals on flowing water, youth passes quickly.
낙화유수.e: Literally 'falling flowers, flowing water', an image of late spring and decline.
